description.value: Pita Pit is a Canadian fast-casual chain specializing in freshly made pita sandwiches, salads, and rice bowls built from a broad selection of proteins, vegetables, and sauces. This Westsyde Road location in Kamloops sits in a strip-mall unit and offers takeout as well as delivery through third-party apps. The menu includes calorie-labelled signature recipes and a fully customizable build-your-own option, making it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a filling, relatively healthy meal.

address.value: 3435 Westsyde Road, Unit 20, Kamloops, BC V2B 7H1
